title: An OAuth app to keep
description: An OAuth app that people use to connect an account. Set issuer, resource, or both authorization_endpoint and token_endpoint. Each URL must be allowed by the deployment's egress rules.

name.description: The app's name. Tools use this name to get the person's token. Use up to 32 letters, digits, - and _.

issuer.description: The authorization server's issuer URL. Its metadata provides the endpoints.

resource.description: The API or MCP server that the tokens are for. If you don't set issuer, Wardrik finds it from this URL.

authorization_endpoint.description: The URL where people sign in, for a service that doesn't publish metadata. Set together with token_endpoint.

token_endpoint.description: The token endpoint. Set together with authorization_endpoint.

client_id.description: The OAuth app's client ID. If you leave it empty, Wardrik registers itself as a client, if the service allows it.

client_secret.description: The OAuth app's client secret, stored in the owner's vault. Wardrik reads it each time it is used, so a new value applies immediately. It is only sent to the token endpoint.

name.description: The name of the secret in the owner's vault.

client_auth.description: How the client secret is sent: post (in the request body) or basic (HTTP Basic auth). Defaults to post.

scopes.description: The scopes to request. Defaults to none.

flow.description: How people sign in. With browser, they sign in in a browser. With device, they enter a code on another device. Defaults to browser.

authorization_params.description: Extra parameters for the browser sign-in, for example access_type: offline. You can't override the parameters Wardrik sets.
